title: SignedPeerRoster v1
description:
The control plane's answer to the only question an agent needs answered: which peers may I exchange clipboard data with right now, and how do I recognise them cryptographically? Closes SPEC_CONTRACT.md gap #4. See ADR-003.

The roster is delivered as detached-signed opaque bytes rather than as a signed JSON object. Verifying a signature over a JSON *object* requires canonicalisation (RFC 8785 JCS), and every implementation that canonicalises differently becomes a signature-bypass bug. Signing the exact transmitted bytes removes that entire failure class: a verifier checks the signature over `payload` as received, and only then parses it.

payload.description: base64 of the UTF-8 JSON bytes of a PeerRoster (see $defs/roster). MUST be signature-verified BEFORE being parsed.

algorithm.description: No algorithm agility in v1. A single hardcoded algorithm cannot be downgraded.

keyId.description: Roster signing key identifier, so the control plane can rotate keys without breaking verifiers.

value.description: Ed25519 signature (64 raw bytes, base64) over the decoded `payload` bytes exactly as transmitted.

rosterVersion.description: Monotonic per-device counter. Increments on every authorization-relevant change. A verifier that has seen a HIGHER rosterVersion MUST reject this one as a rollback attempt.

expiresAt.description: Short. After this instant the roster MUST NOT authorize anything. This is how revocation propagates without push infrastructure: authorization decays by default rather than requiring a successful delivery.

self.description: Binds the roster to one requesting device. A roster issued for device A MUST NOT be honoured by device B.

limits.description: Authoritative payload size limits in bytes. Closes SPEC_CONTRACT.md gap #7 by naming the control plane as the single source of truth, so two agents cannot enforce different ceilings.

scope.description: personal = another device owned by the same user. session = a device reachable only through an explicit, unexpired share session.

sessionId.description: MUST be null when scope is personal, and non-null when scope is session.
